response.sql: WITH per_status AS (SELECT CENTROMEA, AVG(GOT - GPT) AS avg_ast_alt, AVG(APTT - PT) AS avg_aptt_pt FROM Laboratory WHERE WBC > 6.5 GROUP BY CENTROMEA) SELECT AVG(avg_ast_alt) AS avg_of_ast_alt_averages, AVG(avg_aptt_pt) AS avg_of_aptt_pt_averages FROM per_status;

assumptions.assumption: NULL CENTROMEA forms its own group, which GROUP BY does by default. Any empty-string or other distinct value is kept as a separate status and is not merged with NULL.
Each difference is averaged separately, so AVG skips records where that difference is NULL. A record can count toward one average and not the other.
